name: MEAT-GRINDER
source:
MEAT-GRINDER - is a visual novel in which we have to live the life of Obi, a 30-year-old female killer who looks 18 due to genetic abnormalities.

Meet a bunch of memorable and interesting characters on her way!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591230]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《绞肉机》是一部视觉小说，我们在其中扮演奥比的生活，她是一名30岁的女杀手，由于基因异常，她看起来只有18岁。

在途中遇到一群令人难忘且有趣的角色！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2591230]Steam[/url]]
